title: Young Boy in Suburban Backyard, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photograph
back_text_transcription: Gary back yard 3 yrs Aug 18 1955 E654
description: A vintage 1955 black-and-white snapshot depicting a three-year-old boy named Gary standing barefoot in shorts on a large concrete patio in a suburban backyard. The background features modest residential homes and a wooden utility pole with a transformer, exemplifying middle-class American suburban life during the post-WWII boom era. The front edge is date-stamped 'AUG . 55'.
